_comment: 英文覆盖层：按索引对齐 foods/scenes/unis 的中文条目（本文件数组顺序必须与 zh 文件一致）。覆盖 desc/history 叙述字段；名称用各条目已有的 en 字段。
history: Xiamen, ancient Jiahe Isle, was walled in the Ming era; Zheng Chenggong based his fleet here. In 1980 it became one of China's first Special Economic Zones. Gulangyu's world architecture and piano sounds, the island-ring road's sea breeze, and XMU's graffiti tunnel make the 'Garden on the Sea' poetic. Egrets soar over the red-brick houses of Minnan beside a modern skyline.
importance: Special Economic Zone · International Garden City
foods: Sha-cha broth, fragrant and mildly spicy — add toppings as you like.
Minnan oyster omelet with sweet chili sauce — full of sea taste.
Clear sea-worm jelly — the brave Minnan delicacy.
Old-ginger duck in a clay pot — a warming herbal stew.
Huang Zehe's peanut soup, silky sweet — perfect with fried dough.
Noodle paste with seafood — Minnan breakfast.
Braised pork, mushroom and egg yolk in sticky rice — the old-style zongzi.
Gulangyu pastry with mung-bean filling — top souvenir.
scenes: World Heritage — the piano island of world architecture.
China's most beautiful campus — graffiti tunnel and the crescent field.
Thousand-year temple beside XMU, famous for vegetarian pastry.
The island-ring cycling road — sunset at Coconut Village.
'China's most artsy fishing village' — B&Bs and snack streets.
Southeast-Asian arcade blocks — the old Minnan business street.
Built 1894 — the Krupp cannon was world's largest.
An old fishing port turned art district — Cat Street and markets.
Jiageng architecture's red bricks and swallow-tail roofs by the dragon-boat pond.
The city's green lung — black swans in the mangroves.
